description: Returns the signed-in Open-End account (username, e-mail), its credit balance (balance, reserved by running analyses, available) and the scopes of the credential in use. Use it for 'how many credits do I have', before suggesting an analysis, or to check which account the connector is signed in to. Charges nothing. Requires OAuth or an API key.
name: open_end_get_account
title: Get account and credit balance
